name: create_task
description: Create a new task for the user. Use when they say things like add, remind me to, I need to, create a task.

title.description: The task title, extracted from user speech

date.description: Due date in ISO 8601 format or natural language (today, tomorrow, next monday, etc.)

name: update_task
description: Update an existing task. Use when user wants to change title, date, priority, or other fields of a task.

task_name.description: Name/title of the task to update (will fuzzy-match)

name: complete_task
description: Mark a task as complete. Use when user says done, finished, completed, check off.

task_name.description: Name of the task to complete (will fuzzy-match against pending tasks)

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task permanently. Use when user says delete, remove, cancel task. Ask for confirmation before executing.

task_name.description: Name of the task to delete (will fuzzy-match)

name: reschedule_task
description: Move a task to a different date/time. Use when user says move, reschedule, push, defer.

task_name.description: Name of the task to reschedule

name: batch_create_tasks
description: Create multiple tasks at once. Use when user lists several things to do.

name: start_focus_session
description: Start a focus/pomodoro session. Use when user says start focus, focus mode, let me focus.

task_name.description: Optional task to link the focus session to

name: pause_focus
description: Pause the current focus session.

name: resume_focus
description: Resume a paused focus session.

name: end_focus
description: End the current focus session. Use when user says stop, end focus, done focusing.

name: create_circle
description: Create a new accountability circle/group.

name: invite_to_circle
description: Invite someone to a circle.

circle_name.description: Name of the circle to invite to

username.description: Username of the person to invite

name: create_challenge
description: Create a challenge within a circle.

name: post_to_circle
description: Post a message to a circle feed.

circle_name.description: Name of the circle to post in

name: query_tasks
description: Query user tasks. Use when they ask what do I have, show my tasks, what is on my plate.

date.description: Date to query (today, tomorrow, or ISO date)

name: query_schedule
description: Query the user schedule/agenda for a day or range.

name: query_stats
description: Query user stats: streak, XP, level, focus minutes, etc.

name: query_circles
description: Query the user circles and social activity.

name: brain_dump
description: Capture unstructured thoughts that will be processed into tasks later. Use when user says let me dump, brain dump, or speaks a long stream of thoughts.

content.description: Raw brain dump content from user

name: set_preference
description: Update a user preference or setting.
